results.title: Exports more than double in 1st 20 days of November
results.content: Korea's exports more than doubled during the first 20 days of November, customs data showed Monday. Outbound shipments reached $77.4 billion in the Nov. 1-20 period, up from $38.4 billion a year ago, according to the data from the Korea Customs Service. Imports went up 39.4 percent on-year to $50.3 billion over the cited period, resulting in a trade surplus of $27.1 billion.

results.title: Seoul shares open sharply lower amid AI fears
results.content: Korean stocks opened sharply lower Monday, as investors tracked Wall Street losses amid concerns over the artificial intelligence (AI) sector. The benchmark Korea Composite Stock Price Index (KOSPI) fell 135.06 points, or 2.77 percent, to 4,734.9 at the opening bell. On Friday, the KOSPI plunged 5.21 percent, falling below the psychologically important 5,000 mark and marking the lowest closing level in about 10 months since Jan. 16, when it finished at 4,840.74. On Friday (local time), U.S. stocks also tumbled, putting Wall Street on track for its longest losing streak since 2020. Investor sentiment was dampened by growing concerns over tighter U.S. semiconductor export restrictions, following reports that Advanced Micro Devices Inc. results.title: Led by breakout star, Korean golfers combine for 6 wins in LPGA
results.content: Korean golfers combined for six victories on the LPGA Tour in the 2026 season, which ended with the CME Group Tour Championship in Florida on Sunday. It is the same total as 2025, but the big difference is that two of those six wins came at major tournaments this year. Ryu Hae-ran was responsible for both, as the fourth-year player broke out with back-to-back majors at the KPMG Women's PGA Championship in June and the Amundi Evian Championship in July. Ryu, the 2023 LPGA Rookie of the Year, had recorded at least one victory in each of her first three seasons and then reached new heights this season with those two majors. Ryu tied for second in the Player of the Year points, finishing behind Nelly Korda of the United States, who also won two majors and picked up two other tournament wins. results.title: Lee's approval rating rises for 2nd straight week to 37.3%: poll
results.content: President Lee Jae Myung's approval rating rose for the second consecutive week last week to 37.3 percent, a poll showed Monday. In a poll conducted on 2,514 adults nationwide from last Monday to Friday by Realmeter, positive assessments of Lee's job performance rose by 0.9 percentage point from the previous week, while negative assessments fell 1 percentage point to 59.9 percent. Realmeter attributed the rise in Lee's approval rating to diplomatic and economic achievements, including his attendance at the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) and the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summits in the Philippines and China, respectively, as well as his meeting with Chinese President Xi Jinping on the sidelines of the APEC summit. results.title: Kim A-lim falters late, ties for 7th at LPGA season finale
results.content: Kim A-lim has settled for a top-10 finish at the last tournament of the 2026 LPGA Tour season in Florida after faltering in the final round. The South Korean tied for seventh place at the CME Group Tour Championship at Tiburon Golf Club in Naples, Florida, on Sunday (local time) after shooting an 18-under 270 at the par-72 course. It was Kim's 10th top-10 finish of 2026. The 31-year-old held the 54-hole lead at 18-under, but she failed to improve on that score over her final 18 holes. Jeeno Thitikul of Thailand captured her third straight title at 24-under after carding a 65 in the final round and hit a US$4 million jackpot in prize money. Kim opened the final round with a double bogey to fall out of the lead. She bounced back with a birdie on the next hole but then bogeyed the third hole. results.title: N. Korea's Kim says Pyongyang seeks no regional dominance, defending arms buildup as self-defense
results.content: North Korea does not seek regional dominance or expansion, leader Kim Jong-un has said, defending its military buildup as the exercise of its sovereign right, state media reported Monday. Kim made the remarks at a ceremony Sunday, where he received credentials from newly appointed ambassadors from Russia, Sweden, Indonesia, Vietnam, Brazil, the Czech Republic, India, the Philippines, Thailand and Bangladesh, according to the Korean Central News Agency (KCNA). He described a world growing more unstable and unpredictable, one in which some countries put their own interests above international law and trample the sovereignty of others. results.title: 'The Remarried Empress' shows IP synergy as Disney+ hit lifts webtoon views
results.content: Global views for the webtoon "The Remarried Empress" surged 35-fold following the premiere of its Disney+ drama adaptation, highlighting the growing synergy between Korean web content and global streaming platforms. During the two weeks from Nov. 3 to 16, global views for the original webtoon jumped about 35 times compared to the two-week period from Aug. 12 to 25, right before the drama's teaser trailer was released, Naver Webtoon, a digital comics platform operated by Webtoon Entertainment, said Sunday. Viewership increased across all available languages, with Korean-language views soaring 54-fold and English-language views climbing 35-fold. Naver added that downloads and views for the original web novel on Naver Series jumped roughly 45-fold during the same period. results.title: ALL'N wants violin to be hook, not gimmick, in K-pop
results.content: Strings are no strangers to K-pop, usually brought in to lend drama to a track's intro or swell beneath its bridge. Singer-violinist ALL'N, however, asks the instrument to do something harder and more important — carry most of a song's hook. On "Four Seasons," the title track of his first mini album of the same name, out Monday, the violin opens the song, answers the chorus and takes over the final post-chorus, doing the work a vocal hook usually would. "It's easy to add a violin section that sounds impressive, but I want a hook that someone remembers and wants to hear again," the 32-year-old told The Korea Times in a written interview. For the classically trained violinist, who also writes, produces and runs his own agency, the album caps a debut year spent testing how far the instrument can go inside a pop song. results.title: Peugeot moves car shopping to Naver
results.content: Peugeot is moving more of the car-buying journey online by offering vehicle reservations and test-drive bookings through its official Naver store, allowing customers to compare prices and specifications without switching between platforms. The auto brand under Stellantis Korea opened its official store on Naver in October, enabling customers to make purchase reservations for all models sold in Korea. Naver is the nation’s dominant internet portal. In November, the automaker added a test-drive booking function, so customers move from browsing to arranging a test drive without leaving the platform. Previously, customers who wanted to test-drive a vehicle after viewing it on Peugeot’s online store had to use the automaker’s official website.
